# Jan Doležil

> Cybernetics and Robotics student at CTU in Prague, focused on computer
> vision and monocular depth estimation. Online CV, projects and contact.

- Homepage: [https://jan-dolezil.github.io/](https://jan-dolezil.github.io/)

## About

Jan Doležil is working towards an Ing. (MSc) degree in Cybernetics and
Robotics at the Czech Technical University in Prague, Faculty of Electrical
Engineering (CTU FEE).

## Education

- **Ing. in Cybernetics and Robotics** — CTU FEE, Prague (in progress)
- **Bc. in Electrical Engineering** — CTU FEE, Prague, 2023–2026
  - Thesis: *Impact of Camera Parameter Variations on Monocular Depth Prediction*

## Experience

- **Lecturer** — Masarykovo klasické gymnázium Říčany, 2023–2026. Supervised
  the informatics course and led a robotics club.

## Skills

- **Programming:** Python (PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy), C, MATLAB / Simulink
- **Languages:** Czech (native), English (C1), German (conversational)
- **Interests:** computer vision, machine learning, control theory
